lane: Mobile: one app language across signed-out screens and the new account
goal: The language a person picks on the welcome, sign-up or sign-in screens is remembered on the device and carried into their account after sign-in, so the app and the account email locale stop falling back to the phone language.
successCriteria: A language picked while signed out survives an app restart.
After the first sign-in of a new account the app keeps the language picked before sign-in, not the phone language, so the account email locale is not overwritten with the phone language.
Accounts with a saved local or cloud profile keep their own language.
Any language change (auth screens or Settings) updates the device-wide last language.
untouchedSurfaces: Supabase email templates, Edge Functions, migrations and Admin pages are unchanged.
Account-scoped storage keeps its per-account isolation; only the language code is stored device-wide.

impact.entryPoint: Welcome, sign-up, sign-in and Settings language menus; first screen after sign-in.
impact.dataWrite: One new device-wide AsyncStorage key holding only 'vi' or 'en' (or another supported code); account profile storage unchanged.
impact.backendContract: No API change; the existing user_metadata.locale sync now receives the language picked before sign-in instead of the phone language.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; Admin workflow catalog digest for App.tsx is refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: The stored value is a language code only, not personal data; no account data crosses accounts.
impact.observability: No new events; Supabase auth logs show PUT /user when the locale changes.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the extra key is ignored and the app falls back to the phone language as before.

canonicalContracts: apps/mobile/src/i18n.ts detectDeviceLanguage stays the first-run fallback
apps/mobile/src/auth/supabaseAuth.ts updateSupabaseUserLocale stays the only email-locale writer

sourceReview.reason: Owner decisions on device language and email locale this fix completes.
Signed-out scope has no storage prefix, so its profile (and language) is never saved: root cause.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before edits; PLAN.md updated in the same PR.

securityReview.sensitiveData: Only a language code is stored outside account scope; no journal, birth or identity data.
securityReview.externalInput: Stored value is validated with normalizeLanguage before use.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No migration; needs a new Android build to reach phones (Owner action).
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if any account-scoped data would need to be shared across accounts.

managerTestPath: Phone set to English, fresh install: choose Tiếng Việt on the welcome or sign-up screen, close and reopen the app (still Vietnamese), sign up (Vietnamese email), confirm, sign in (app stays Vietnamese), then use Forgot password (Vietnamese email).
residualRisk: Device behaviour not verified until a new Android build is tested; an account already switched to English by the old build keeps 'en' until the person changes language once.

dependencyReview.evidence: Uses the already-installed AsyncStorage package; no new API claims.
